scope: Declared licenses returned by locked Cargo metadata filtered to aarch64-apple-darwin, for the normal AND dev dependencies of chirp-crypto-core with default features (ed25519-dalek is a dev-dependency but is already in the normal tree through vodozemac). Includes registry packages, not a completed legal or shipping-notice audit. The crate itself is proprietary and declares no license. rusqlite is built with the "bundled" feature: libsqlite3-sys is MIT, and the SQLite C source it compiles is in the public domain. c448 added the uniffi family (MPL-2.0, approved in E2EE-DESIGN section 11); uniffi_core is linked into the iOS static library, the other uniffi_* crates are proc-macro/build-time. MPL-2.0 is file-level copyleft: uniffi is used unmodified, so shipping needs its notices kept and a pointer to its public source. The aarch64-apple-ios and aarch64-apple-ios-sim resolutions were checked and are identical to this set. No GPL, LGPL or AGPL package appears in either list.

packages.name: rustix
packages.license: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT

bindgen_tool_scope: Additional packages that resolve only with --features bindgen-cli (the uniffi-bindgen binary used by scripts/build-ios.sh to generate the Swift bindings). They run on the build machine and are never linked into the app or the static library. Same metadata filter as above.
